subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should this issue remain the cross-path terminal tool-error contract, or should maintainers split it into the broader placeholder thread and the incomplete-turn quarantine thread?
rationale: Current main partially fixes the placeholder cluster, but the remaining exec-warning and lastToolError fallback branches are behavior-policy choices that overlap other open items and could change channel warning noise.

options.title: Keep Cross-Path Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open as the maintainer-owned contract tying placeholder safety, exec failure visibility, and no-payload incomplete-turn fallback together.

options.title: Split To Existing Threads
options.body: Move the placeholder evidence to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96857 and the payloadCount=0/session-state evidence to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97324, then close this only after preserving its unique comments.

options.title: Queue A Narrow Warning/Fallback Repair
options.body: Authorize a focused repair for exec-like no-reply warnings and lastToolError payloadCount=0 fallback while leaving the broader media-placeholder cluster open.

recommendation.title: Keep Cross-Path Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the maintainer-owned contract tying placeholder safety, exec failure visibility, and no-payload incomplete-turn fallback together.
